notes: All prices include taxes. Same data as plans.md. Bundles with a null speed run at the speed of the caller's main plan.

plans.name: Go Week
plans.spoken_summary: Go Week costs forty pounds for seven days. You get two gigabytes and fifty minutes.
fine_print: It does not renew by itself. The customer must buy it again each week.
Roaming passes cannot be used on this plan.
Unused data and minutes end when the seven days end.

plans.name: Go Mini
plans.spoken_summary: Go Mini costs seventy pounds for thirty days. You get three gigabytes and one hundred minutes.
fine_print: Renews automatically from the balance.
Unused data does not roll over.
Roaming passes cannot be used on this plan.

plans.name: Go Youth
plans.spoken_summary: Go Youth costs one hundred ten pounds for thirty days. You get twelve gigabytes and one hundred fifty minutes.
fine_print: Only for customers aged sixteen to twenty-five, checked against the national ID.
On the first renewal after the customer's twenty-sixth birthday, the line moves to Go Smart.
Unused data does not roll over.

plans.name: Go Smart
plans.spoken_summary: Go Smart costs one hundred thirty pounds for thirty days. You get eight gigabytes and three hundred minutes.
fine_print: Renews automatically from the balance.
Unused data does not roll over.
Minutes cover all Egyptian mobile and landline numbers.

plans.name: Go Plus
plans.spoken_summary: Go Plus costs two hundred twenty pounds for thirty days. You get twenty gigabytes and six hundred minutes.
fine_print: This is the only prepaid plan with rollover. Up to five gigabytes of unused data carries over for one renewal.
Rollover is lost if the plan does not renew on time.
Five G works only in the areas listed as five G in the coverage file.

plans.name: Flex Silver
plans.spoken_summary: Flex Silver costs three hundred pounds a month. You get thirty gigabytes and one thousand minutes.
fine_print: Unused data does not roll over.
Data stops at the limit unless Auto Boost is switched on.
Eligible for device installments after six months with Nabda.

plans.name: Flex Gold
plans.spoken_summary: Flex Gold costs four hundred seventy-five pounds a month. You get sixty gigabytes and two thousand minutes.
fine_print: Up to ten gigabytes of unused data carries over for one billing cycle.
Rollover is lost if the line is barred or suspended on the bill date.
Five G works only in the areas listed as five G in the coverage file.

plans.name: Flex Platinum
plans.spoken_summary: Flex Platinum costs eight hundred pounds a month. You get one hundred fifty gigabytes and five thousand minutes.
fine_print: Includes three free Zone One roaming days each billing cycle. Unused days do not carry over.
Unused data does not roll over, even though this is the largest plan.
After the data limit, speed drops to five megabits per second instead of stopping.

plans.name: Home Fiber Fifty
plans.spoken_summary: Home Fiber Fifty costs four hundred fifty pounds a month. You get four hundred gigabytes at speeds up to fifty megabits per second.
fine_print: After the data limit, speed drops to ten megabits per second.
Installation costs five hundred pounds once, and is free with a twelve-month contract.
Available only in fiber areas listed in the coverage file.

plans.name: Home Fiber Two Hundred
plans.spoken_summary: Home Fiber Two Hundred costs eight hundred fifty pounds a month. You get one thousand gigabytes at speeds up to two hundred megabits per second.
fine_print: After the data limit, speed drops to twenty-five megabits per second.
Installation costs five hundred pounds once, and is free with a twelve-month contract.
A move up from Home Fiber Fifty takes effect on the next bill date.

plans.name: Home Air Lite
plans.spoken_summary: Home Air Lite costs three hundred fifty pounds a month. You get one hundred fifty gigabytes at speeds up to thirty megabits per second.
fine_print: The four G router costs nine hundred pounds once.
The router works only at the registered address.
Data stops at the limit. Only Boost Month can be added.

plans.name: Home Air Pro
plans.spoken_summary: Home Air Pro costs six hundred fifty pounds a month. You get four hundred gigabytes at speeds up to three hundred megabits per second.
fine_print: The five G router costs one thousand five hundred pounds once.
Available only at addresses in five G areas. The router falls back to four G when five G is weak.
Data stops at the limit. Only Boost Month can be added.

plans.name: Boost Day
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Day costs fifteen pounds for one day. You get one gigabyte.
fine_print: Lasts twenty-four hours from the moment it is bought, not until midnight.
This is the bundle Auto Boost buys, up to three times per billing cycle.

plans.name: Boost Week
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Week costs fifty pounds for seven days. You get five gigabytes.
fine_print: Does not renew by itself.
Cannot be used while roaming.

plans.name: Boost Month
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Month costs one hundred twenty pounds for thirty days. You get fifteen gigabytes.
fine_print: This is the only bundle with rollover. Up to five gigabytes carries over if the same bundle is bought again before it ends.
This is the only bundle that works on Home Air Lite and Home Air Pro.

plans.name: Boost Night
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Night costs twenty-five pounds for seven days. You get ten gigabytes.
fine_print: Works only from one a.m. to seven a.m. Cairo time.
Outside those hours, data comes from the main plan.

plans.name: Boost Social
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Social costs thirty-five pounds for thirty days. You get six gigabytes.
fine_print: Covers only the chat and social apps listed in the Nabda app.
Voice calls and video calls inside those apps use main plan data.

plans.name: Boost Talk
plans.spoken_summary: Boost Talk costs forty pounds for thirty days. You get two hundred minutes and no data.
fine_print: Minutes cover Egyptian numbers only. International calls are not included.
Unused minutes end after thirty days.
